messages:
max: FYI found a customer case where a streaming reconnect + truncated toolcall caused two billable toolcall entries. trace=0xabc123
max: repro steps loosely: start stream -> server-side toolcall triggered -> client reconnects mid-stream -> server retries toolcall on resume but suffix was trimmed so both entries looked valid to ledger
elaine: ugh. do we have an idempotency token for toolcalls tied to session?
sanjay: there is a session_id on the stream metadata but we only use it for routing, not billing dedupe
elaine: can we attach a toolcall_id generated at request start and pass it with resumptions? would help dedupe
max: the tricky part: trimming/truncation changes the toolcall payload (we strip the trailing partial token chunk), so simple payload-hash dedupe fails
ops-bot: notice: deployment "stream-ledger-guard" rolled at 2026-03-20T12:14:03Z to canary
max: log snippet from the affected pod:
```
I0320 11:02:05 stream.go:412 Starting toolcall id=rcv-752
I0320 11:02:07 toolrunner.go:88 Called tool id=rcv-752 payload_len=512
I0320 11:02:09 stream.go:489 reconnect: session=sess-99 resume_from=offset:120
I0320 11:02:10 toolrunner.go:88 Called tool id=rcv-753 payload_len=360 (truncated)
I0320 11:02:11 ledger.go:210 BillEntry created entry_id=led-420 amount=0.05 meta=tool:rcv-752
I0320 11:02:11 ledger.go:210 BillEntry created entry_id=led-421 amount=0.05 meta=tool:rcv-753
```
elaine: so two different tool ids (rcv-752 vs rcv-753). ledger can't tell they were the same logical call because payloads differ post-truncation
sanjay: two mitigation axes: 1) client-facing idempotency key passed by SDK (preferred) 2) server-side heuristic: if toolcalls from same session overlap in token-range and timestamps are within X ms, mark provisional and wait for confirmation
max: UI shows both as confirmed charges already which hits customer directly. can we make provisional by default on resume-triggered toolcalls?
elaine: provisional flags would help but we need an automated finalization policy to avoid leaving charges hanging forever
sanjay: propose: provisional window 10s, if a duplicate with matching start_token within window is seen, collapse to single confirmed charge with earliest entry_id, otherwise promote after window
max: edge-case: what about background embed jobs where latency >10s? they'd get incorrectly collapsed
elaine: right, we should scope heuristics to streaming-resume flows only (session resume metadata present) and exclude batch/background paths
ops-bot: idea: add a billing attribute on toolcall: origin=[stream|batch] and resume_hint=true/false
max: next steps I suggest:
- SDK: add `x-toolcall-id` optional header (devex) (elaine)
- Server: mark resume-origin toolcalls as provisional and implement 10s dedupe window heuristic (sanjay)
- Console: show provisional state in cost timeline and allow ops to force-commit (max)
elaine: I'll sketch the SDK header today; default to random UUID on stream start and include on subsequent resumptions
sanjay: I'll prototype provisional ledger entries and the collapse routine in ledger service. will instrument metrics: provisional_count, collapsed_count, promotion_latency
max: also need a migration plan for existing confirmed duplicate disputes (support ticket: CID-4321). ops, can we bulk-check traces for trace=0xabc123 pattern?
ops-bot: running search job: query="trace:0xabc123 AND ledger.created>=2026-03-01" -> results will be posted in #support-ops
elaine: one more thought — what about model inference tokens vs toolcall tokens? need to ensure token attribution doesn't double-count when toolcall payloads are trimmed
max: agreed, add token-range metadata to provisional entries: {start_token, end_token, session_id} (for debugging only in initial rollout)
sanjay: ok let's sync tomorrow with a short 15m to align on API and UX. I'll draft the server PR and tests before sync
max: thanks — this should reduce customer surprises. :thumbsup:
